small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d kernel is compute-bound at 74% SOL but register-limited to 33% theoretical occupancy (56 regs/thread). Hoist the IC loop to the outermost position and the kd/kh/kw loops inside, precompute the validity masks once per (kd,kh,kw) outside the IC loop (already done), and reduce register pressure by using smaller BLOCK_OC×BLOCK_SP tiles like (16,32) with num_warps=2, or alternatively try (32,32) with num_stages=3 to overlap loads. Add autotune configs with maxnreg hint or smaller tiles to push occupancy above 50%.
large_guidance: Redesign as a true im2col-style GEMM: gather inputs per (n, output-tile) into a [BLOCK_SP, IC*KD*KH*KW] tile and multiply against a [IC*KD*KH*KW, BLOCK_OC] weight tile using tl.dot for tensor-core acceleration. Currently the kernel does scalar FMAs in a 3-deep nested kd/kh/kw/ic loop producing 27*IC=432 serial iterations per output element with no tl.dot, which leaves the compute pipelines underutilized. Rewriting as a tl.dot-based GEMM with BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=16 (operand SMEM ~6KB, fits easily) and a single K-loop over (ic,kd,kh,kw) flattened should yield 3-5x speedup on the conv_transpose3d kernel which is 97% of runtime.
